hypotheses.HE2: La recuperación histórica alcanzará un desempeño Top-k y MRR superior al de las estrategias de recuperación normativa, mientras que las variantes normativas jerárquicas y de conjunto candidato ampliarán la cobertura documental en posiciones más profundas.
hypotheses.HE5: Los errores y límites del piloto se concentrarán en descripciones ambiguas o incompletas, subpartidas jerárquicamente próximas, casos con precedentes históricos insuficientes y condiciones que restringirán la validez de los resultados al conjunto interno evaluado.

HE2.exact_text: La recuperación histórica alcanzará un desempeño Top-k y MRR superior al de las estrategias de recuperación normativa, mientras que las variantes normativas jerárquicas y de conjunto candidato ampliarán la cobertura documental en posiciones más profundas.

HE2_A.rule_applied: Each family is SUPPORTED_BY_PRIMARY_EVIDENCE because all five frozen 99% marginal CI lower bounds are greater than zero; all three family dispositions are supported.

HE2_B.rule_applied: G3F03-0016 has ci_lower greater than zero. Each A_historical_defined Phase E variant has Pool@50 < Pool@100 < Pool@200, so the descriptive pattern is directionally consistent; no new interval or test was calculated.

limitations: The primary inference is cluster-resampling uncertainty within a fixed internal Chapter 87 benchmark, not external-population inference.
Phase E evidence is descriptive and does not replace HE2_A or the hierarchical HE2_B primary contrast.
Historical retrieval superiority does not establish the accuracy of the complete RAG framework.

HE5.exact_text: Los errores y límites del piloto se concentrarán en descripciones ambiguas o incompletas, subpartidas jerárquicamente próximas, casos con precedentes históricos insuficientes y condiciones que restringirán la validez de los resultados al conjunto interno evaluado.

HE5.rule_applied: INCONCLUSIVE because a literal concentration proposition is not estimable and another lacks a prospective concentration threshold; absence of evaluability is not contrary evidence.
limitations: Ambiguous or incomplete descriptions were not operationalized.
Hierarchy and precedent-support evidence remains descriptive.
Internal benchmark scope is documented but does not establish external validity.

EXP11B.mandatory_limitation: the ten paired H150/H200 banks do not define a seed superpopulation and 10 x 1056 are not independent observations

architecture_guardrails: Historical ranking, normative evidence retrieval, and controlled explanation are separate functions.
Normative evidence retrieval is not binding legal correctness.
Auditable explanation is not classification or legal correctness.
The local LLM explains preselected candidates; it does not classify from scratch or replace historical ranking.
